profile_text.body:
Meta is a public company founded in 2004 and headquartered in Menlo Park, CA, trading on public markets under the ticker META. Its llama.com site presents Meta as a platform for AI developers, offering access to its models and tools through the Meta Model API, which is described as compatible with the OpenAI SDK. The site highlights several products under the Muse family: Muse Spark, described as a coding-optimized model built for writing, reviewing, and shipping code with lower latency; Muse Code, a coding agent built to run Muse Spark; Muse Image, a reasoning model that plans layout before drawing and is available via the Meta Model API at $0.01 per image; and Muse Glimmer, described as a 30-billion-parameter open model optimized for local agent workflows and small enough to run on a Mac or PC with a single consumer GPU. The site also describes capabilities including search grounding for live web access and multi-agent workflows where a single model can interact with a computer by clicking through apps and moving between interfaces.

Meta's tracked AI product is the Llama open-weight model family, noted as commonly self-hosted. The company reported revenue of $200,966,000,000 for the period ending 2025-12-31 per its 10-K filing, and holds SEC CIK number 0001326801. Several MCP servers associated with Meta's advertising infrastructure appear in the registry, covering campaign management, creative testing, and performance analysis across Facebook and Instagram. Meta is also named in three active legal cases: Neural AI, LLC v. Meta Platforms, Inc. in the Western District of Texas, Chicken Soup for the Soul, LLC v. Meta Platforms Inc. in the Northern District of California, and Kadrey v. Meta Platforms, Inc., also in the Northern District of California.
